facts.fact: A World Bank-funded pilot in N'Djamena registers refugees biometrically in the SIGPTS and issues National Refugee Identification Numbers (NNIRs), with UNHCR hoping to expand to 25,000 IDs and eventually all refugees aged ten and above, per Biometric Update citing UNHCR.
More than 4,000 refugees in N'Djamena had received NNIR identity documents as of 1 May 2025, against a pilot target of 7,000, per Biometric Update citing UNHCR.

systems.system: Integrated Population and Secure Documents Management System (SIGPTS)
